主模型.name: Main Model
主模型.tooltip: Place the main model file (preferably .gguf) in ComfyUI/models/LLM/.

视觉投影mmproj.name: Vision Projector (mmproj)
视觉投影mmproj.tooltip: Multimodal input requires an mmproj file. Select None for text-only use.

保留历史think.name: Preserve Thinking History
保留历史think.tooltip: Applies to Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and Qwen3.8. When enabled, <think> blocks from previous turns are preserved. Disabled by default to save context tokens.

上下文长度.name: Context Length
上下文长度.tooltip: Corresponds to llama.cpp n_ctx. Qwen3.8 supports up to 262144 natively; ordinary image analysis rarely needs the full limit.

GPU层数.name: GPU Layers
GPU层数.tooltip: Corresponds to llama.cpp n_gpu_layers. -1 offloads as many layers as possible to the GPU; 0 uses CPU only.

KV缓存K类型.name: KV Cache K Type
KV缓存K类型.tooltip: Corresponds to llama.cpp --cache-type-k / type_k. The default is recommended; q8_0 may improve speed for models larger than 27B.

KV缓存V类型.name: KV Cache V Type
KV缓存V类型.tooltip: Corresponds to llama.cpp --cache-type-v / type_v. The default is recommended; q8_0 may improve speed for models larger than 27B.

MoE专家上CPU.name: MoE Experts on CPU
MoE专家上CPU.tooltip: Qwen3.6-VL only. Places all MoE expert weights in system memory. This is mainly a fallback for limited VRAM and may not be faster.

前N层专家上CPU.name: First N MoE Layers on CPU
前N层专家上CPU.tooltip: Qwen3.6-VL only. Values above 0 place the MoE expert weights from the first N layers on the CPU. Ignored when MoE Experts on CPU is enabled.

Qwen3_8推理强度.name: Qwen3.8 Reasoning Effort
Qwen3_8推理强度.tooltip: Qwen3.8 only. xhigh prioritizes quality (the model default), medium balances quality and speed, and low prioritizes speed. Ignored when thinking is disabled.

输入模式.name: Input Mode
输入模式.tooltip: Image analyzes the first image from every connected image input together; Frame by Frame processes the main image input one frame at a time; Video samples the main image input and processes the frames together; Text uses text only and does not require an image.

最多帧数.name: Max Frames
最多帧数.tooltip: The number of frames sampled evenly from the input image sequence in Video mode.

最大边长.name: Max Edge Length
最大边长.tooltip: Input images are proportionally downscaled to this maximum edge length and encoded as optimized JPEG at quality 90. The default of 1024 prevents large images from consuming too much visual context.

最大生成token.name: Max Output Tokens
最大生成token.tooltip: The UI accepts a 64-bit integer maximum. The actual output length is still limited by the model context length and available VRAM.

温度.name: Temperature
温度.tooltip: Qwen3.8 recommended values are applied automatically: 1.0 with thinking and 0.7 without thinking. A manually changed value is preserved.

top_p.name: Top P
top_p.tooltip: Qwen3.8 recommended values are applied automatically: 0.95 with thinking and 0.80 without thinking. A manually changed value is preserved.

top_k.name: Top K
top_k.tooltip: The Qwen3.8 recommended value is 20. A manually changed value is preserved.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed. Use ComfyUI's after-generation control to keep it fixed, increment it, decrement it, or randomize it.

输出think块.name: Output Think Block
输出think块.tooltip: Enabled preserves the model's original <think>...</think> output. Disabled removes think blocks from the final result only.

生成后自动卸载模型.name: Auto-unload Model After Generation
生成后自动卸载模型.tooltip: Automatically runs Qwen Llama TE Unload Model after generation to release model VRAM.

图片.name: Image
图片.tooltip: Main image input. In Image mode, it can be sent to the model together with Image 2 through Image 8.

图片2.name: Image 2
图片2.tooltip: Additional Image-mode input; only the first image is used.

图片3.name: Image 3
图片3.tooltip: Additional Image-mode input; only the first image is used.

图片4.name: Image 4
图片4.tooltip: Additional Image-mode input; only the first image is used.

图片5.name: Image 5
图片5.tooltip: Additional Image-mode input; only the first image is used.

图片6.name: Image 6
图片6.tooltip: Additional Image-mode input; only the first image is used.

图片7.name: Image 7
图片7.tooltip: Additional Image-mode input; only the first image is used.

图片8.name: Image 8
图片8.tooltip: Additional Image-mode input; only the first image is used.

QwenTE_ChatSettings.display_name: Qwen Llama TE Chat Enhancement Settings

系统提示词.name: System Prompt
系统提示词.placeholder: Optional. When a Skill is connected, the Skill provides the system rules.

最大生成token.name: Max Output Tokens
最大生成token.tooltip: The UI does not impose an upper limit. The actual length is limited by the model context length.

最大边长.name: Max Edge Length
最大边长.tooltip: Images inserted into the conversation are scaled by their longest edge.

skill.name: Skill
skill.tooltip: Auto-select matches a Skill to the first task. You can also select a fixed Skill.

主模型.name: Main Model
主模型.tooltip: Place the Gemma4 main model file (preferably .gguf) in ComfyUI/models/LLM/.

视觉投影mmproj.name: Vision Projector (mmproj)
视觉投影mmproj.tooltip: Gemma4 multimodal input requires an mmproj file. A BF16 mmproj is recommended for E2B/E4B audio. Select None for text-only use.

启用思考.name: Enable Thinking
启用思考.tooltip: Gemma4-specific enable_thinking. The newer handler notes that it mainly applies to 31B/26BA4B; keep the default for E2B/E4B in most cases.

GPU层数.name: GPU Layers
GPU层数.tooltip: Corresponds to llama.cpp n_gpu_layers. -1 offloads as many layers as possible to the GPU; 0 uses CPU only.

输入模式.name: Input Mode
输入模式.tooltip: Image uses only the first image; Frame by Frame processes images one at a time; Video samples frames and processes them together; Text uses text only and does not require an image.

最多帧数.name: Max Frames
最多帧数.tooltip: The number of frames sampled evenly from the input image sequence in Video mode.

最大边长.name: Max Edge Length
最大边长.tooltip: Scales input images by their longest edge to improve speed.

最大生成token.name: Max Output Tokens
最大生成token.tooltip: Official Gemma4 image examples use 512. Increase this manually for longer text responses.

温度.name: Temperature
温度.tooltip: Gemma4's officially recommended sampling value is temperature=1.0.

top_p.name: Top P
top_p.tooltip: Gemma4's officially recommended sampling value is top_p=0.95.

top_k.name: Top K
top_k.tooltip: Gemma4's officially recommended sampling value is top_k=64.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed. Use ComfyUI's after-generation control to keep it fixed, increment it, decrement it, or randomize it.

输出think块.name: Output Think Block
输出think块.tooltip: Enabled attempts to preserve Gemma4 thinking text. Disabled keeps only the final answer and removes channel-control markers.

思考预算token.name: Thinking Budget Tokens
思考预算token.tooltip: The reasoning_budget setting in newer llama-cpp-python versions. -1 is unlimited; 0 ends immediately after thinking begins; values above 0 limit the token count of the first Gemma4 thought channel.

音频路径或URL.name: Audio Path or URL
音频路径或URL.tooltip: Enter a local WAV/MP3 path or a data:audio/... URI. When an AUDIO socket is also connected, the AUDIO input takes priority.

图片路径或URL.name: Image Path or URL
图片路径或URL.tooltip: Optional. Supports a local image path, an http(s) image URL, or a data:image/... URI for the newer Gemma4 combined image-and-audio input.

最大边长.name: Max Edge Length
最大边长.tooltip: Used only to scale local images or ComfyUI image inputs by their longest edge.

最大生成token.name: Max Output Tokens
最大生成token.tooltip: Official Gemma4 multimodal examples commonly use 512. Increase this for longer responses.

温度.name: Temperature
温度.tooltip: Gemma4's officially recommended sampling value is temperature=1.0.

top_p.name: Top P
top_p.tooltip: Gemma4's officially recommended sampling value is top_p=0.95.

top_k.name: Top K
top_k.tooltip: Gemma4's officially recommended sampling value is top_k=64.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed. Use ComfyUI's after-generation control to keep it fixed, increment it, decrement it, or randomize it.

输出think块.name: Output Think Block
输出think块.tooltip: Enabled attempts to preserve Gemma4 thinking text. Disabled keeps only the final answer and removes channel-control markers. A BF16 mmproj is recommended for Gemma4 E2B/E4B audio.

思考预算token.name: Thinking Budget Tokens
思考预算token.tooltip: The reasoning_budget setting in newer llama-cpp-python versions. -1 is unlimited; 0 ends immediately after thinking begins; values above 0 limit the token count of the first Gemma4 thought channel.
